audience: analytics and data teams that query Data Sources and endpoints in one Tinybird workspace

useCases.title: Browse Data Sources and their schemas
useCases.text: List the Data Sources of the workspace, then read the schema and settings of one Data Source.

useCases.title: Run a published endpoint
useCases.text: List the Pipes, then run one endpoint with its parameters and read the returned rows.

useCases.title: Answer a question with read-only SQL
useCases.text: Run one SELECT or WITH query against the workspace and read the rows it returns as JSON.

useCases.title: Check a background job
useCases.text: List the recent jobs, then open one job to see its kind, status and error.

useCases.title: Append events to a Data Source
useCases.text: Send NDJSON rows to one Data Source. Each call appends the rows again, so a repeated call adds duplicates.
